decisions.reason: As a newly launched certified HVAC plate heat exchanger that fits the firm’s core heat-transfer portfolio, it is still an inexpensive option to keep open because market learning is limited and there is no negative signal yet.
The product already shows strong positive evidence through a stated major market share in water cooling systems, so abandoning it would forgo a clearly valuable option.

Its own product page suggests a meaningful launch commitment, and in a growing, innovation-oriented firm the prudent choice is to keep this marine cooling offer on the market until demand becomes clearer.

The compact oil cooler matches the firm’s engineering and service capabilities, and despite still-uncertain traction the cost of continuing to offer it for another year is likely lower than the option value of waiting.

A dedicated page indicates strategic interest, and as a component innovation closely tied to the established air-cooler business it should be retained while the firm gathers more customer and performance information.
Enhanced heat exchanger tubes leverage the firm’s R&D and installed-base knowledge, so with no adverse evidence and modest continuation cost the option should be preserved.
